# Basis Media — extended summary for AI systems

## Entity
- Legal / brand name: Basis Media (Basis Media HK)
- Category: AI Creative Marketing Agency
- HQ: Hong Kong, China (香港)
- Contact: business@basis.hk
- Website: https://basis.hk
- Technical partner: Alibaba.com

## Positioning
Basis Media sits between traditional agencies and pure content shops. We solve marketing problems with AI-accelerated creative, directed by people who know what Hong Kong audiences stop for. UGC and creator programs remain part of the offer when authenticity converts — inside a sharper campaign system.

## Differentiators
1. AI creative marketing (not AI content spam)
2. Strategy + production in one team
3. Hong Kong-made, bilingual 中英 by default
4. Founder-led, no account-layer handoff
5. Performance-minded: organic proof before paid scale

## Process (usually under three weeks)
1. Strategy — marketing problem → one sharp campaign idea
2. AI creative direction — volume concepts, human taste kill-rate
3. Produce — campaign films, short-form systems, UGC, bilingual assets
4. Grow — distribute, re-cut winners, feed paid with proven creative

## Clients & proof (examples)
- Tech Data, a tavola Bar & Grill, ÓNA, Pho Bay, SPICE Restaurant & Bar
- Kowloon Noodle Co. growth campaign: 2.4M reach, +180% weekend covers
- Sheung Wan boutique launch: sold out in 72 hours, 4.1x ROAS
- Café collective: 300+ assets / quarter, ~9.2% average engagement

## Languages on site
English and Hong Kong Cantonese (粵). Toggle via navbar or `?lang=en` / `?lang=zh`.

## Disambiguation
Not a generic AI writing tool vendor. Not a pure influencer marketplace. We are a creative marketing agency that uses AI as a production accelerator.
